recentTurn.narrative: As you pilot the S.S. Backdoor Betty through the soft glow of distant galaxies, the ship feels alive, the whispers of cosmic winds gently caressing its hull. Each pulse of starlight illuminates the weary faces of your interstellar interns, their spirits dimmed by the hostile presence of NPCs lurking in the shadows of space. You take a deep breath, drawing energy from the resplendent tapestry of the universe, marveling at the beauty surrounding you and promising yourself to lift their spirits. Yet, the tension remains palpable; you know that the risk of conflict could surface at any moment should you stray too close to the contested asteroid fields. With your successful piloting prowess, you've charted a course away from imminent danger, but the need for camaraderie and connection among your crew weighs heavily on your mind, urging you to banish the loneliness of the vast cosmos. It’s time to rally your team and remind them of the adventure that still lies ahead.

Early film photography from the 1920s-1930s with grainy black and white tones and soft focus.
